Help & Guide
How to use JESUS Bible
Read Bible: Open Bible → choose book → choose chapter.

Save Verse: Tap Save on any verse.

Bookmark: Mark important verses.

Highlight: Highlight verses you want to remember.

Notes: Add personal reflections to any verse.

Verse Card: Create a beautiful shareable image.

Memory Mode: Hide words to memorise Scripture.

Listen: Tap Listen to hear the chapter.

Reading Plans: Follow a daily plan.

Prayer: Send a prayer request.

🇮🇳 Hindi: Tap the Hindi button on the Bible page.
